from.place: proof, first paragraph: finite separable field extensions are classified by finite continuous G-sets

title: Open subgroups of an absolute Galois group
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], and G=Gal(K^sep/K) with its Krull topology. For every open subgroup H of G, the fixed field L=(K^sep)^H is a finite separable extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] of K, H=Gal(K^sep/L), and the transitive G-set G/H is finite and discrete continuous. Conversely, the stabilizer in G of a point in any finite transitive discrete continuous G-set is open and the fixed field of that stabilizer is finite separable over K.
